LogOddsPool provides a flexible, weighted linear basis for combining raw model outputs, addressing heteroskedasticity through adaptive weights. MMC-Contribution scales these combined signals based on matchup-specific factors, implementing a soft attention mechanism over historical data. Extremization-Tuner modulates the uncertainty estimates produced by LogOddsPool, capturing exogenous factors like rest and travel that affect outcome variance. Finally, FalsifyBind generates robust prediction intervals by simulating from the posterior predictive distribution, providing a non-parametric way to quantify uncertainty. Together, they enable a principled approach to sports forecasting that separates signal extraction, contextual adjustment, and uncertainty quantification, while also allowing for systematic model checking through falsification.
